requirements.name: Georgia passenger-carrier certificate when required
requirements.subject: company
requirements.citation_text: No person or entity to whom or to which this Subchapter applies shall operate as or hold itself out to be a passenger carrier without first obtaining a passenger carrier certificate from the Department in accordance with Subchapter 2 of this Chapter.
requirements.requirement_text: Maintain the Georgia DPS passenger carrier certificate if the operation is not statutorily exempt and is within the intrastate passenger-carrier rules.
requirements.notes: Critical exception: O.C.G.A. 40-1-100(12)(B)(vii) for vehicles capable of no more than ten persons used exclusively for elderly or disabled transportation to/from care/prescriptions. Do not require DPS certificate for every NEMT van.
